name: yandex-search-mcp
description: Search the web with the Yandex Search API.
long_description: Returns ranked Yandex web results with titles, snippets, and URLs. Read-only. To run it you need a Yandex Cloud API key and a folder id; the server refuses to start without both.

api_key.title: Search API key
api_key.description: Yandex Cloud API key for Search API v2.

folder_id.title: Folder ID
folder_id.description: Yandex Cloud folder id that owns the Search API key.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web using Yandex Search API. Returns ranked results with titles, snippets, and URLs. Use when the user wants web pages from Yandex for a query, with titles, snippets, URLs, a region, or a safe-search filter. Do not use it for how often people search a phrase; this server has no keyword-volume tool.
